What you can print

Upload your own image as PNG, JPG or HEIC up to 15 MB: a logo, a drawing, a photo or a meme for your friends. Add text such as a name, a date or a quote. In the designer you can move and resize the image, and you see the result on the garment in 2D and 3D right away.

A classic hoodie: something for the cold season, a team outfit or a gift with a name on it. The size range is wider than the T-shirt’s, from XS to XXXL.

No idea of your own? Look through the market of LOOM designers’ work and put the print you like on your garment. To the market

Delivery and payment

In Tashkent a courier delivers 2–4 working days after production; delivery is 30 000 UZS. For the regions of Uzbekistan we tell you the time and price when we confirm the order. You pay upfront and in full by transfer to the LOOM card, with a receipt; production starts once our team confirms the payment.

Frequently asked questions

Which sizes and colours are there?

Sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL and XXXL; colours white and black. You choose the size before adding to the cart.

How fast do you deliver?

In Tashkent, 2–4 working days after production; delivery is 30 000 UZS. For the regions we tell you the time and price when we confirm the order.

How do I pay?

You pay for the order upfront and in full, by transfer to the LOOM card. The card number and exact amount are on the payment page. Transfer within 30 minutes and upload a screenshot of the receipt — the receipt is required. Payme, Click and Uzum Bank are coming soon.

What images can I upload?

PNG, JPG or HEIC, up to 15 MB. The print area is 30 × 40 cm. You must have the right to use the image.

Can I return an item?

A printed garment is made just for you, so we replace it only if it has a production defect or does not match the approved mockup. Blank garments can be returned within 14 days.

Will the colours match the screen?

Printing on fabric can differ slightly from the screen, which is normal.
